pictures.name: EZ1-Water-Gate-Square
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A wide stone city square in ancient Jerusalem by a great city gate, early morning. A huge crowd of returned families, men, women and elders in worn travel robes and headscarves, gathering and looking toward the middle of the square, where a tall wooden platform stands. Newly rebuilt stone walls behind, golden dawn light on the stones, deep blue shadows. The platform in the middle. Homecoming, longing, anticipation. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: EZ2-Ezra-Platform
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Seen from behind and below: Ezra the scribe, an elderly man with a long grey beard and a white linen robe with a blue fringe, seen only from behind or far away, his face never visible, stands on the high wooden platform above the crowd, holding a large closed scroll on two wooden rollers. A few elders in white stand beside him. Below, a sea of faces looks up, men and women of all ages. Golden morning sun, deep blue shadows across the square. The scroll in the middle. Expectant, solemn, hushed. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: EZ3-They-Stand
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The great crowd in the Jerusalem square rising to its feet all at once, faces lifted, hands raised, old men helped up by grandchildren. Far off on the high wooden platform, Ezra the scribe, an elderly man with a long grey beard and a white linen robe with a blue fringe, seen only from behind or far away, his face never visible, holds the scroll open wide above them. Brilliant gold morning light streams across the crowd, deep blue shadows. The rising crowd in the middle. Awe, reverence, one movement. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: EZ4-People-Weep
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Close among the crowd in the Jerusalem square: an old man with a white beard covers his face with his hands, a woman in a deep blue headscarf weeps openly, a young man bows his head. Far behind and above them, the high wooden platform with a small figure holding an open scroll, seen from behind. Soft gold light, deep blue shadows. The weeping faces in the middle. Tender, moved, honest. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: EZ5-Feast-Shared
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Evening in the streets of ancient Jerusalem: families sharing a feast at long low tables, bread, figs, grapes, roasted lamb and jugs of wine; a woman hands a covered basket of food to a poor old widow at a doorway; children laughing. Lanterns strung along the stone walls. Warm gold lantern light, deep blue evening sky. The basket being handed over in the middle. Joy, sharing, celebration. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: EZ6-Today-Gospel-Raised
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Inside a modern parish church during Mass, painted in the same sacred oil style: a deacon in a white alb and stole, seen from behind, carries a large ornate gold-covered book held slightly raised before him as he walks to the lectern; two servers with tall candles walk beside him. The congregation of ordinary people of many ages is standing. Warm gold candlelight, deep blue shadows and stained glass. The raised book in the middle. Joy, reverence, attention.
